system.description:
A remote ascetic tradition — hermits who practise in isolation, with no students and no lineage.

  • Mountain Communion: Fast Healing doubles when meditating in a natural outdoor environment for 12 hours. On a turn in which you do not move, your Stun Attack's save DC is 2 higher.
  • Unshaken Mind: Advantage on saves vs mind-affecting effects (stacks with Iron Mind bonus rather than replacing it).
